ideas.title: Investigating Welfare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the allegations of welfare fraud in Minnesota, including the potential enabling by Governor Tim Walz.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate potential corruption
questions: What is the extent of welfare fraud in Minnesota?
Is Governor Tim Walz involved in enabling fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and possible corruption within the Minnesota state government. By following the money and investigating the allegations, we may be able to expose a significant issue.
